meta.title: Clear rates and full control — WiizePay
meta.description: See what it costs to get paid by Pix, boleto and card with WiizePay, and how billing, invoices, contracts, clients and financial management come together in one place. No monthly fee and no hidden costs.

hero.subtitle: So much more than rates: billing, invoices, contracts, clients and financial management in one place. See what each way of getting paid costs — no monthly fee and no hidden costs.

pix.title: Pix
pix.note: For installment or recurring Pix, the fixed fee applies to each installment/charge, depending on the type.

boleto.title: Boleto
boleto.desc: Offer boleto payments, one-time or in installments.
boleto.note: The fixed fee for each tier applies to every boleto/installment.
boleto.recurringHint: Same fee as one-time · fixed fee on every charge

cards.title: Cards
cards.subtitle: Progressive fees based on the number of installments.
cards.note: The fixed fee is charged only once per sale, even for installment purchases.
cards.recurringHint: Same fee as single payment · fixed fee on every charge

services.title: Additional services
services.subtitle: Additional features can be used as your operation needs them.

anticipation.title: Early payout
anticipation.desc: Advance your receivables whenever you need.
anticipation.subtitle: Receive your money before the original settlement date.

sim.title: Simulate your next charge.
sim.subtitle: Choose installments and who pays the fee. The calculation uses the same rules as charge creation.
sim.cardFixedOnce: For credit cards, the fixed fee is charged only once per sale.
sim.fixedEach: The fixed fee is charged on each installment.
sim.disclaimer: Estimate based on current rules. The final amount is confirmed when the charge is created.

faq.title: Questions about fees?
faq.q1: Is the fixed fee charged per installment?
faq.a1: For installment Pix and boleto, the fixed fee is charged on each installment or charge. For credit cards, the fixed fee is charged only once per sale.
faq.a2: No. You only pay the fees for the transactions and services you use.
faq.q3: Can I get early payout on my receivables?
faq.a3: Yes. Only receivables that are already paid and eligible can be advanced, and the cost is shown before you confirm.

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.subtitle: Get paid in a simple, secure way, integrated with your operation.

debit.title: Account debit
debit.desc: Get paid once or in installments directly by account debit.
debit.note: The fixed fee is charged once per sale, including installment payments.

dunning.title: Get paid without turning collection into work.
dunning.subtitle: WiizePay follows every due date and keeps your customer informed through the right channels. Fewer delays, fewer repetitive conversations and more time to grow.

desc.essential: The right touch for simple, objective collections.
desc.smart: More channels working together to improve your chances of getting paid.
desc.intensive: Complete follow-up for payments that need maximum attention.

dunning.note: Flat price per individual charge, not per message. Each installment and each recurring cycle is a separate charge. Available balance is required.

promo.body: One-time Pix and boleto: only the fixed fee.
promo.fixed: For the first 3 months after creating your account, the percentage is zero. The fixed fee per charge still applies.
promo.note: New accounts only. Installment or recurring Pix, installment boleto, cards and anticipation keep their regular fees.
promo.stripPix: 0% percentage fee for new accounts during the first 3 months. Afterward, one-time Pix returns to {{rate}} + fixed fee.
promo.stripBoleto: 0% percentage fee for new accounts during the first 3 months. Afterward, one-time boleto returns to {{rate}} + fixed fee.
